unitTitle: Choose a home and describe a neighbourhood
title: TCF corner
subtitle: A2 · Unit 6: Choose a home and describe a neighbourhood

steps.title: Exam style
steps.body: These questions look like the real TCF Canada: one play, four options, one answer. A wrong and a blank answer both score zero, so always choose.

steps.fr: Le studio est moins cher que l'appartement d'une chambre. Le stationnement intérieur coûte soixante-quinze dollars de plus chaque mois.
steps.question: What costs an extra $75 per month?
steps.explain: The speaker names indoor parking as the extra monthly cost.

steps.fr: La bibliothèque est plus près du logement A. L'épicerie est à trois minutes du logement B.
steps.question: Which home is closer to the grocery store?
options: Neither home has a grocery store
steps.explain: The speaker says the grocery store is three minutes from home B.

steps.fr: Le bail est d'un an. Les frais d'électricité ne sont pas compris dans le loyer.
steps.question: Which statement is correct?
options: The lease is one year and electricity is extra.
The lease is six months and electricity is included.
The lease is one year and parking is included.
The lease is two years and heat is extra.
steps.explain: Both details are stated in the recording.

steps.prompt: What is included in the monthly rent?
steps.explain: The notice says outdoor parking is included.
steps.promptFr: STUDIO À LOUER — 1 300 $ par mois. Meublé. Stationnement extérieur compris. Buanderie au sous-sol. Visite sur rendez-vous.

options: The home is five minutes from the train.
steps.explain: The notice places the apartment five minutes from the train.
steps.promptFr: APPARTEMENT À LOUER — Une chambre, 1 500 $ par mois. Chauffage central compris. À 5 minutes du train. Frais d'électricité en plus.

options: Confirm the visit time by email
Sign the lease before the visit
steps.explain: The notice asks the reader to confirm the visit time by email.
steps.promptFr: VISITE — Samedi à 11 h. Merci de confirmer votre heure par courriel. Adresse : près de la bibliothèque de quartier.
